- Species label variants (case, trailing spaces, misspellings: Gentoo , adelie, Adeile, Chinstarp, Gentto, Chinstrap ) normalized to allowed values Adelie, Chinstrap, Gentoo.
- body_mass_g stored as text with commas; cast to numeric for aggregation.
- Row 36 excluded because flipper_length_mm = -200 is out of allowed range 170-235 per rules.

Total body mass per species (grams) on cleaned data (42 rows used):
- Adelie: 50,825
- Chinstrap: 35,900
- Gentoo: 103,500
